Malignant Chain.effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target. At the end of the Round, if the Target was Poisoned by this Move, roll their Loyalty, get at least 3 successes, if it fails, from the next Round the Target becomes the user's Ally untl the poison is healed.

Nightmare.effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition. Deal 1 Typeless Damage to the Target after every attempt to resist its Sleep Condition where it doesn't wake up.

Perish Song.effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Three Rounds after this Move is used, deal damage to those affected equal to their remaining HP. Removing from battle prevents this effect.

Sleep Talk.effect: If the user is not asleep, this Move fails. Instead of making a roll to try to wake up, the user may choose to use Sleep Talk instead. Choose a Move on the user's Move set at random and Target Random foe with it. Sleep Talk can be repeated up to 5 times per Round.

Snore.effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.

Yawn.effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.

decisions.Malignant Chain: Printed Poison+ icon and source JSON agree on Badly Poisoned despite abbreviated Poison prose. One raw Loyalty roll at the end of the infliction round; failure changes battle side next round until poison is cured. Ownership is unchanged.
decisions.Nightmare: One indirect damage after each unsuccessful wake attempt, never a round-end tick.
decisions.Perish Song: Remaining HP indirect damage at end of cast round + 3; individual departure cancels; normal Area target rules retained.
decisions.Yawn: Sleep at start of cast round + 1 with immunity checked at delivery; individual departure cancels.
decisions.Sleep Talk: Uniform host d6 rejection sampling over all known moves and eligible foes. Normal intrinsic Self/Area targeting retained. Selected move uses ordinary pipeline and spends one action, up to five. Recursive or unsupported selections stay committed for explicit GM failed-attempt adjudication.
decisions.Snore: Asleep-only normal attack, 3 Chance Flinch. Sleep actions replace wake attempts.
